pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and frequent stellate projections. The spatial area of the dark patches is significantly greater than the surrounding light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph with frequent tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane visible along the upper neck profile exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serration against the background foliage.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple localized, raised, and crusty textural disruptions with dark brown hyper-pigmentation observed on the upper shoulder and flank area, disrupting the underlying patch patterns.
